visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled brown hair and clear-framed glasses opens a white-framed glass door, stepping from an outdoor asphalt area into an indoor space. He is wearing a grey crew-neck sweatshirt and black trousers. The outdoor background features multi-story residential buildings with blue and red tiled facades. (2) Inside the shop, the man walks toward a woman with long, straight black hair wearing a black sweatshirt and light grey jeans. The room is a mix of a workspace and a retail showroom, containing a white desk with a laptop, boxes on the floor, and a clothing rack with various sweaters in the background. Lighting is bright and even. (3) The man and woman stand near several open cardboard boxes filled with packaged clothing. He points to his own grey sweatshirt, which has a small circular logo on the right chest. She hands him a black sweatshirt to examine. The camera remains at eye-level, following their interactions closely. (4) The scene shifts to the man speaking directly to the camera. Large numerical text overlays appear next to him, showing '170' and '54'. The woman stands beside him with her hands on her hips. They are positioned in the center of the frame against a backdrop of clothes on hangers. (5) A third person, a larger man wearing a black t-shirt, glasses, and a gold chain, enters the frame. The first man hands him a black sweatshirt. The setting remains the same indoor shop environment with bright artificial lighting. (6) The larger man puts on a grey hoodie. The first man adjusts the garment, pointing to the fit around the belly area and sleeves. They both look into the camera, explaining the sizing. The camera pans slightly to keep all characters in frame. (7) The video concludes with a series of high-quality static photographs showing the man and woman posing in grey and black sweatshirts in stylized settings like a grey concrete wall and a parking garage. Red and white text slogans appear at the bottom of these images.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with the sound of a glass door latch clicking and opening. A high-energy electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 kick drum starts immediately. A male voice speaks enthusiastically with a rising intonation. (2) As he enters the room, the male host and a female speaker engage in a fast-paced, casual conversation. A brief laughter track SFX is triggered when a joke is made about the boss. The music remains a consistent background layer. (3) Subtle rustling sounds of plastic and cardboard are audible as the speakers move around boxes. The vocal tone is friendly and slightly exaggerated for comedic effect. (4) A second male voice enters, exhibiting a slightly deeper pitch. The BGM tempo remains constant, providing an energetic pulse. Short digital 'ding' SFX punctuate the appearance of on-screen height and weight statistics. (5) The dialogue continues regarding clothing sizes, with voices overlapping as they compare different sweatshirts. A whoosh SFX marks a quick visual transition. (6) The video concludes with the BGM swelling slightly in volume during the final photo slideshow, followed by a quick fade out of both vocals and music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase for the clothing brand 'atdc garage'. It uses a casual vlog-style interaction to demonstrate the fit and sizing of their new sweatshirt line, particularly emphasizing how larger sizes can flatter different body types and effectively conceal the stomach area. It concludes with a direct sales call-to-action mentioning limited stock.
